title: The Hunt's Stand's grief-bargain silently requires the literal 'argue him out of/off' persuasion checks at Colm and Marrick to have each been attempted, not just the equivalent outcome from the Envoy's 'broker a shared claim' line — nothing in the weigh text or the Wood Question quest warns that the two systems track separately.
